verdict.rationale: Thoropass documents a native Risk Register that replaces spreadsheets. It supports 4×4 or 5×5 risk scoring matrices and lets you track, evaluate, and remediate risks. A dedicated role manages assigned risks, including the controls and action items linked to them, which covers scoring, ownership, treatment and control linkage. missing for 10: explicit evidence of scheduled risk review cycles or recurring reassessment, detailed docs on treatment-plan structure (accept/mitigate/transfer), independent or hands-on corroboration.
